where: Landing proof strip and active workout note

sandbox: Fresh /demo context; record every request while opening and completing a sample set, then assert all are same-origin.

claim: Demo sample data is separate and never saved with real data
where: Landing action, demo banner, demo documentation
sandbox: Fresh context; create a routine at /?demo=1, navigate to /, and assert the real ledger does not show it.

claim: Corrections are new rows; earlier values remain inspectable

claim: A JSON backup includes and restores reusable routines and ledger events without overwriting existing records
sandbox: Fresh /demo context; inspect an exported backup, delete and restore its routine, then edit locally and prove restoring the older backup keeps the local edit.

sandbox: Fresh /demo context; change a CSV row while retaining its event ID, import it, and assert both original and imported values remain.

claim: Active workout state and its start and finish events are committed atomically
sandbox: Fresh /demo context; start and finish a sample workout, reading IndexedDB transactions to assert active state and matching boundary events change together.

claim: Free keeps two routines while the ledger and CSV export remain available

sandbox: Fresh /demo context; add a second routine, assert New routine is disabled with the free-limit explanation, then prove the sample ledger can still export CSV.

claim: A valid one-time license unlocks unlimited routines and the on-device training summary
where: Landing paid-tier section, More, README, Terms
sandbox: Fresh /demo context; use a routed valid Sociobot verification fixture, assert the summary is visible, and create a third routine.
